evidenceClasses.summary: A legal active declaration pays its authoritative costs and resolves exactly once.
An illegal active declaration is rejected without spending or mutation.
An eligible allied recipient is accepted while non-allies are excluded.
A reviewed alternate rules-text branch selects and resolves its distinct outcome.
One geometric resolution contains both eligible and ineligible or affected and unaffected recipients.
A bounded value below its cap changes by the canonical amount.
A value already at its cap remains unchanged and records a cap/no-op outcome.
An authorized participant selects one stable legal option and only that branch resolves.
A canonical condition change is applied with its source and duration.
A canonical condition prevention or immunity blocks only the applicable condition effect.
Critical-hit behavior follows the reviewed ability policy and modifier order.
An eligible enemy recipient is accepted while non-enemies are excluded.
A field, weather, terrain, room, hazard, or zone change is created from authoritative state.
A field-owned effect expires or is removed exactly once at its canonical boundary.
A form, copy, disguise, or transformation projection is applied from an immutable authoritative snapshot.
A form, copy, disguise, or transformation projection restores or cleans up at the canonical boundary.
A successful hit branch receives the canonical ability effects.
A canonical HP, temporary-HP, injury, healing, or loss operation applies its bounded amount.
A canonical HP prevention, affordability rule, or pool cap prevents or limits the operation.
A relevant immunity prevents only the effects it canonically blocks and records the source.
Competing Interrupt or Reaction windows resolve in deterministic canonical priority order.
A held-item or inventory operation applies atomically to the authoritative item resource.
A missing, ineligible, protected, or stale item rejects or omits the operation without partial mutation.
Expiry, switch, knockout, source loss, cancellation, or scene cleanup removes an effect exactly once.
An effect triggers exactly once at its canonical authoritative lifecycle boundary.
A missed attack applies no hit-only ability effect while retaining canonical declaration costs.
Authoritative movement, displacement, teleport, or swap reaches a legal destination and pays its cost.
Illegal or stale movement is rejected without moving or partially spending resources.
A stale consulted or written map, sheet, inventory, or pending resource rejects the whole resolution.
Nested ability/event execution terminates at reviewed cycle and depth limits without duplicate effects.
An authorized participant declines the current optional window and resolution continues exactly once.
An effective Static ability contributes its canonical provider automatically.
A suppressed, replaced, copied-away, or absent ability contributes no passive provider.
A server-owned recorded draw selects the reviewed random branch.
Refresh or reconnect restores the same authorized pending state and permits one continuation.
An unauthorized or ineligible viewer receives no hidden ability, responder, option, roll, or sheet detail.
Duplicate or uncertain delivery returns the original result without rerolling, respending, or reapplying.
The source is resolved as the canonical self recipient without accepting an unrelated target.
Loss or suppression of the source ability removes only source-linked temporary state at the reviewed boundary.
A canonical stat or Combat Stage operation applies its reviewed value.
A canonical stat or Combat Stage prevention or cap leaves the value unchanged.
A state, roll, distance, relationship, or resource threshold fails and omits the guarded effect.
A state, roll, distance, relationship, or resource threshold passes and applies the guarded effect.
A matching accepted event and effective ability create or resolve exactly one eligible trigger.
A nonmatching event, suppressed ability, exhausted usage, or failed predicate creates no trigger.
An exhausted scene, daily, round, or turn resource prevents an additional use.
The authoritative lifecycle reset restores exactly the canonical usage pool.
An accepted ability spends the correct usage amount atomically and once.

requirements.summary: Apply for mutually distinct reviewed rules-text branches.
Apply when an authorized participant chooses an option or may decline.
Apply when type, ability, condition, item, field, or other immunity is consulted.
Apply when a recorded server draw selects mechanics or recipients.
Apply when a predicate or threshold gates an effect.
Apply when one accepted event may cause another ability, move, or event.
Apply to condition application, cure, prevention, reflection, or transfer.
Apply to ability-owned attack or damage resolution.
Apply to weather, terrain, room, hazard, vortex, zone, or battlefield state.
Apply to forms, copies, disguises, illusions, and transformations.
Apply to HP, temporary HP, healing, loss, injury, or damage reduction.
Apply to Interrupt, Reaction, Priority, redirection, or cancellation timing.
Apply to held items, inventory, berries, food, pickup, drop, steal, or consume behavior.
Apply to delayed, duration-based, source-linked, or boundary-triggered effects.
Apply to voluntary or forced movement, displacement, teleport, swap, or anchor constraints.
Apply to stats, Combat Stages, evasion, initiative, or speed modifiers.
Apply to finite scene, daily, round, turn, cooldown, or multi-use resources.
Apply to abilities declared through an active command or reviewed action choice.
Apply to automatic providers from the effective ability projection.
Apply to abilities subscribed to accepted authoritative events.
Apply when ability identity, eligibility, options, rolls, or targets may be hidden.
Apply when an ability opens durable resumable state.
Apply whenever an ability mutates, spends, rolls, emits an event, or opens a window.
Apply when more than one authoritative resource is read or written.
Apply when temporary state depends on the source retaining an ability or remaining present.
Apply when a value can cap or become an intentional no-op.
Apply when at least one branch requires or affects allies.
Apply when geometry may include multiple independently eligible recipients.
Apply when at least one branch requires or affects enemies.
Apply when at least one branch targets or directly affects the source.
